say.en: Your own name has a first name and a family name. Carolus Linnaeus gave every living thing a two-part name in the same way. In this lesson: State the meaning of binomial nomenclature.
Apply the rules for writing scientific names.

title.en: Two parts of a scientific name

body.en: *Binomial nomenclature*, given by Carolus Linnaeus, names every organism with two words. The first word is the genus and the second is the specific epithet. In Mangifera indica, Mangifera is the genus and indica is the specific epithet.
body.kn: ಲಿನ್ನಿಯಸ್ ನೀಡಿದ ದ್ವಿನಾಮ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೀವಿಗೆ ಎರಡು ಪದಗಳ ಹೆಸರು. ಮೊದಲನೆಯದು ಜಾತಿ (genus), ಎರಡನೆಯದು ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಸೂಚಕ ಪದ. Mangifera indica ಯಲ್ಲಿ Mangifera ಜಾತಿ, indica ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಸೂಚಕ.

narration.en: A scientific name has two parts: the genus and the specific epithet. The genus starts with a capital letter and the epithet with a small letter; printed names are in italics and handwritten ones are underlined separately; the name of the author who first described it may follow in short form.
narration.kn: ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಹೆಸರಿಗೆ ಎರಡು ಭಾಗ: ಕುಲ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಸೂಚಕ. ಕುಲ ದೊಡ್ಡಕ್ಷರದಿಂದ, ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಸೂಚಕ ಸಣ್ಣಕ್ಷರದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭ; ಮುದ್ರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಇಟಾಲಿಕ್, ಕೈಬರಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ; ಮೊದಲು ವಿವರಿಸಿದ ಲೇಖಕರ ಹೆಸರು ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತವಾಗಿ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರಬಹುದು.

passage.en: A scientific name has two parts: the __1__ name comes first and the specific epithet second. The names are in __2__, so they are printed in italics or, when handwritten, __3__ separately. body.en: Names are in Latin or Latinised and are printed in italics. When handwritten, the genus and the epithet are underlined separately. The genus begins with a capital letter and the epithet with a small letter. The author's name may follow in short form, as in Mangifera indica Linn.
body.kn: ಹೆಸರುಗಳು ಲ್ಯಾಟಿನ್ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದು ಓರೆ ಅಕ್ಷರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುದ್ರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೈಬರಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡೂ ಪದಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಅಡಿಗೆರೆ ಹಾಕಬೇಕು. ಜಾತಿಯ ಹೆಸರು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಕ್ಷರದಿಂದ, ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಸೂಚಕ ಸಣ್ಣ ಅಕ್ಷರದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭ.

problem.en: A student writes the scientific name of the potato as "solanum Tuberosum" in a record book. Correct it and explain each correction.

steps.en: The genus must start with a capital letter: Solanum.
The specific epithet must start with a small letter: tuberosum.
In handwriting, underline Solanum and tuberosum separately because italics cannot be shown.

answer.en: Solanum tuberosum, with each word underlined separately
